mapper.select: SELECT id, team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM teams WHERE id = #{id} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}

SELECT id, team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM teams WHERE team_code = #{teamCode} AND delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value}
SELECT id, team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at, delete_flag FROM teams WHERE team_code = #{teamCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO teams (team_code, team_name, department_code, created_at, updated_at, delete_flag) VALUES (#{team.teamCode}, #{team.teamName}, #{team.departmentCode}, #{team.createdAt}, #{team.updatedAt}, #{team.deleteFlag})
mapper.update: UPDATE teams SET delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@DELETED.value}, deleted_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id}

UPDATE teams SET team_name = #{teamName}, department_code = #{departmentCode}, updated_at = #{updatedAt}, deleted_at = NULL, delete_flag = ${@com.uit.sociuscoremodules.shared.enums.DeleteFlagEnums@NOT_DELETED.value} WHERE id = #{id}
